name: html-to-mp4-converter
description: Convert HTML animations to MP4 video

scripts.build:linux: npx caxa --input . --output dist/html2mp4-linux --exclude node_modules/express --exclude node_modules/express-rate-limit --exclude node_modules/multer --exclude node_modules/archiver --exclude node_modules/@supabase --exclude node_modules/@upstash --exclude node_modules/busboy --exclude .git --exclude public --exclude dist -- "{{caxa}}/node_modules/.bin/node" "{{caxa}}/cli.js"
scripts.build:win: npx caxa --input . --output dist/html2mp4-win.exe --exclude node_modules/express --exclude node_modules/express-rate-limit --exclude node_modules/multer --exclude node_modules/archiver --exclude node_modules/@supabase --exclude node_modules/@upstash --exclude node_modules/busboy --exclude .git --exclude public --exclude dist -- "{{caxa}}/node_modules/.bin/node" "{{caxa}}/cli.js"
